memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — June 14, 2026

Portfolio is down 12.1% since inception with equity at $8,794 vs $10,000 start. The dominant driver of losses is MOMENTUM, which has generated -$1,027 across 20 trades (7W/13L, 35% win rate). This is materially below the break-even rate required given the asymmetric stop/profit structure (~20% stop, ~18% profit target), which mathematically needs roughly 53% wins to break even. The engine is demonstrably unprofitable and was correctly disabled in the prior session.

Critical pattern: MOMENTUM repeatedly entered geopolitical YES positions (Iran deal, Hormuz, US invasion) that reversed hard — suggesting the signal is chasing news-driven pumps into thin, mean-reverting markets. Additionally, the SMART_CONSENSUS trade on a CS:GO esports match lost $385 on a $1,000 stake, implying dangerously oversized single bets relative to current bank.

SHORT_FAVORITE shows small positive PnL ($58 realized) on limited trades and merits continued operation. The Israel airspace open position (-$147 unrealized at current price 0.982) is a concern — entry was 0.835 on a NO, and the market has moved strongly against us.

Current config (MOMENTUM/SMART_CONSENSUS disabled, kellyMult at floor 0.10, maxEventExposure at 500) is appropriate given the drawdown. No changes warranted this session. Patience is the discipline — wait for VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW to generate trades before drawing conclusions on those engines.
observations: MOMENTUM engine: 35% win rate across 20 trades, -$1,027 PnL — structurally loss-making at current stop/target ratio, correctly disabled
SMART_CONSENSUS: 1 trade, -$385 — $1,000 stake on a single esports match was irresponsible sizing; engine disabled
SHORT_FAVORITE: 2 trades, 1W/1L, +$58 — small edge visible, insufficient sample to conclude
VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW: zero trades — no data to evaluate, engines are enabled but not firing
Brier score 0.285 indicates meaningful calibration gap — model predicted ~60-62% on most MOMENTUM losers but realized win rate was 35%
Geopolitical event clustering: multiple Iran/Hormuz trades all stopped out, suggesting regime-blind momentum entry into news-pump reversals
Open position 'Israel closes airspace NO' at entry 0.835, current 0.982 — significant mark-to-market loss (~$118) with binary resolution risk
MaxEventExposure at $500 and kellyMult at 0.10 are appropriate floors given -12% drawdown
Prior large stakes ($800 on individual sports matches) contributed disproportionately to losses — sizing discipline has improved
Hypothesis FORMING on MOMENTUM low-priced non-sports: 45.5% win rate, CI [22-69%] — insufficient to act on yet
changeReasoning: No changes from prior session config. MOMENTUM and SMART_CONSENSUS remain disabled — both have demonstrated negative expected value over meaningful sample sizes and disabling them is data-justified, not reactive. SHORT_FAVORITE remains on with positive PnL. VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW remain enabled to allow evidence to accumulate. All sizing parameters (kellyMult 0.10, maxExposure 0.35, maxEventExposure 500) remain at conservative levels appropriate for a portfolio in 12% drawdown. Increasing any sizing parameter now would be premature given no new positive evidence. Await at least 10-15 settled trades from active engines before reconsidering.
